betaReferences.meaning: Bottom-up operating-beta proxy estimates from food processing; household consumer products is an adverse adjacent-sector sensitivity, not a measured VNM beta or exact peer set.

countryExposure.adverseEstimate: Domestic sales retain VN CRP; all foreign sales assigned Laos CRP, one known group operating jurisdiction; this is deliberately adverse, not actual geographic allocation or a mathematical maximum of all countries.
countryExposure.primary: Full Vietnam country ERP as a group operating-location proxy; report says production assets primarily in Vietnam.

countryTable.providerVintageLabel: January5_2026; mutable page includes later country updates; no PIT/version inference

macroAndWaccInputs.defaultSpreadLimitation: Rating-based spread is an approximate local sovereign-credit adjustment, not a verified VND CDS or exact currency/tenor-matched spread. Main range is a documented analyst estimate, not guaranteed WACC bounds.
macroAndWaccInputs.doubleCountControl: Deduct provider sovereign default estimate once from VND government reference, then add explicit country equity premium once; mature ERP=total VN ERP minus country ERP. No addition of country ERP to total ERP and no TCB beta transfer.

funding.limitations: Mixed-currency expense/book-debt proxy, not a quoted marginal lending rate. Sovereign reference floor is a conservative model choice; NCI book value proxies market value; no claim debt stayed unchanged through October.
funding.zeroDebtStressMeaning: An all-equity operating-cost stress removes financing tax-shield/weight assumptions for the conservative comparison; does not assert VNM has zero debt or unrestricted net cash.

tax.reason: Q3 tax note reports group rates10–21%; use20–21% for this conservative estimate, not a claim all entities pay20%.
